title: Rethinking Streaming Video Diffusion Model: Context, Execution, and Training
abstract: arXiv:2609.22283v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Understanding the design space of streaming video diffusion is essential to exploring its potential for generation quality and computational efficiency. We develop a unified analytical framework that relates model and sampler choices, historical conditioning, execution scheduling, and training strategies. The framework accommodates a broad family of causal context-selection policies and makes their computational dependencies and training-inference alignment explicit. Within this design space, we study three representative policies: clean, same-level, and progressive history. On the full VBench prompt set, same-level and progressive history achieve aggregate scores of 85.24 and 85.60, respectively, compared with 84.45 for the clean-history reference. translated_title: 重新思考流式视频扩散模型：上下文、执行与训练
translated_abstract: 理解流式视频扩散的设计空间对于探索其在生成质量和计算效率方面的潜力至关重要。我们开发了一个统一的分析框架，将模型与采样器的选择、历史条件化、执行调度和训练策略联系起来。该框架能够容纳广泛的因果上下文选择策略族，并使它们的计算依赖关系以及训练与推理之间的一致性变得清晰明确。在这一设计空间内，我们研究了三种代表性的策略：干净历史、同级历史和渐进历史。在完整的VBench提示集上，同级历史和渐进历史分别取得了85.24和85.60的综合得分，而干净历史基线为84.45。长视频对比实验进一步表明，采用渐进历史策略可以获得更好的主体一致性和更连贯的运动效果。通过允许多个去噪节点一起处理，渐进历史策略……
tldr: 本文提出了一个统一分析框架来系统研究流式视频扩散模型中的上下文选择、执行调度与训练策略，并证明渐进历史条件化策略能显著提升生成质量以及长视频的主体一致性与运动连贯性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a unified analytical framework to systematically study context selection, execution scheduling, and training strategies for streaming video diffusion models, demonstrating that progressive history conditioning improves generation quality along with subject consistency and motion coherence in long videos.
